_comment: inn collision proxy (Blender frame, Z up; ws = 2.793 world m per raw unit). Ground body at the measured ground-floor wall planes (x -1.39..1.34 = the stone corner/mid columns' face so no concave pockets between columns, y +/-1.29); the porch posts + knee-rail benches (y to +/-1.94) and the porch awnings are dropped (thin/overhang). Upper jettied floor as its own box at the upper wall planes (x -1.78..1.76, y +/-1.19), underside z 1.0 = 2.79 m world, above walk-head so you walk under the jetty and only a jump clips it. Entrances: mirrored stone steps at the arched doors on BOTH +/-Y faces (x +/-0.24): the staircase run is only ~0.5 m world deep, too shallow for two capsule treads, so each door gets ONE probe-mount step box, top 0.1074 raw = 0.30 m world (probe-safe rise <= 0.32) with the front extended ~8 cm world past the bottom stone; feet stand ~0.09 m under the visible top stone tread at the door. Bases extend -0.3 below terrain. Veranda rails (both porches): the measured rail/bench segments as solid boxes to rail-top height (0.185 raw = 0.52 m world, too tall to auto-step so they BLOCK), extended inward to meet the door-step box so the gaps beside the step are sealed (they were narrower than the capsule and would pinch); the veranda interior stays reachable over the step. Roof: two wedges (ridge along X); the porch awnings and dormers stay uncollided. ROOFS refitted by fit_proxy.py (plane-fitted sloped SLABS + flat caps): the top is the least-squares fitted roof plane and the underside follows it, so porch/awning roofs no longer hang a flat prism bottom over open space (the anvil/rim pin class).
